name: Red Wings Airlines
verdict: Airline within Rostec's management perimeter; on the chest of FC Baltika's shirt in 2026-27.
note: Rating note: Rostec's own site (June 2023) places Red Wings within the state corporation's management perimeter, and RBC (April 2024) describes it as 'part of the Rostec state corporation'; the equity holder shown by press is Rostec's Airline Asset Management (no primary page opened). Propose severe (controlled by the Russian state through Rostec while Russia's war in Ukraine goes on; mirrors Gazprom/Aeroflot).
